content: Technical indicator libs 2025/2026: pandas-ta v0.4.71b0 (2025-09-14) now requires Python>=3.12 and is yearly-maintenance (Snyk: inactive); community fork pandas-ta-classic (253 indicators, no TA-Lib needed). 'ta' (bukosabino/ta) v0.11.0 (2023-11) pure-Python pandas, MIT, no C deps, stable but stale. TA-Lib needs a C library install (build pain). Recommend 'ta' for simplicity/no-deps or pandas-ta-classic for breadth.
